# foreman_katello_content_credential (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "foreman_katello_content_credential" "rpm_gpg_key_centos7" {
  name = "RPM-GPG-KEY-CentOS-7"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the katello content credential to look up.

### Read-Only

- `content` (String) Content of the content credential
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
